description: Weak, distributed unit. Fires most strongly when the player to move owns the centre-column cell on the third row (row 2) with column 3 at least three high, the cells to its right in column 4 (rows 2-3) still empty, and no opponent stone at (2,2), (0,1) or (0,2). Typical top boards have column 3 alternating me/them from the bottom and my stone at (1,2). Many weaker firings fit no clean pattern.
effect: None measurable: forcing it high or to zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.1 in any column, with no consistent direction.
notes: Band-9 cell histograms: (2,3) mine 97%, (1,3) theirs 89%, (3,3) theirs 82%, (1,2) mine 83%; col4 height <=2 in 88%. In act minimal pairs, many single opponent stones (at (0,1), (0,2), (2,2), (2,4), (3,4)) each kill top activations, so the effect looks additive over many cells rather than one predicate. Scores: p1 F1 .139, p2 .177, p3 (hand-weighted) .174, p4 (strict col-3 alternation) .132, p5 .206 (best, sim share 0.08). Mid-band firing is diverse; this may be a random direction. Synthesis reached 7.87, below the dev max of 8.83.
